 First Alert: Flooded roadways and thunderstorms as heavy rain hits New England 
 It's a First Alert day, and there's a flood warning in place for southeastern Mass. through Saturday morning. Boston weather details, live radar below. 
 By Sydney Welch • 
 Published November 6, 2026 • 
 Updated on November 7, 2026 at 12:46 am 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 A few more showers could linger Saturday as the wet weather makes its way out of New England. Watch the video to see what else to expect this weekend.
 A flash flood warning was issued for parts of southeastern Mass., and a severe thunderstor m was issued for the same area as well as parts of Cape Cod and Rhode Island, after a flood watch was issued for a larger area. These have since expired. See details here and explore live weather radar below. 
 Heavy rain, localized flooding and a few thunderstorms are all possible as an unsettled stretch of weather takes over southern New England heading into the weekend. 
 Stream NBC10 Boston news for free, 24/7, wherever you are.
   WATCH HERE 
 NBC10 Boston NBC10 Boston 
 First Alert is in place today, with the heaviest rain likely setting up south of Boston, including the South Shore, Cape and Islands. 
 Widespread 1 to 3 inches of rain is expected, but where the line of heaviest rain sets up, totals of 4 to 5 inches are not out of the question. Rain will remain widespread through the day, with the heaviest downpours expected in the afternoon and continuing into Friday night.

 Flood watch
 A Flood Watch is in effect for southeastern Massachusetts through Saturday morning. 
 NBC10 Boston NBC10 Boston 
 The biggest concern is street flooding in spots with poor drainage, but streams and creeks will be rising, and low spots will start to pick up water. Fallen leaves clogging storm drains could make matters worse. 
 A few thunderstorms are also possible near the South Coast Friday night, although widespread severe weather is not expected. 
 Temperatures will remain unusually mild for early November.
 Floodwaters impacted roadways in southeastern parts of the state Friday.
 Weekend rain?
 The first round of rain begins tapering off early Saturday morning with cloudy morning and early afternoon on tap. Another round of showers comes in Saturday afternoon to evening. Some of these showers could produce brief heavy downpours and even small hail. 
 Most of Sunday will be dry once the sun comes up, but a few lingering showers are possible Sunday morning for areas north of the Mass Pike. 
 Temperatures will gradually cool through the weekend, with highs in the upper 50s Sunday. By next week, a cooler but mainly dry weather pattern settles across the region.
